planItems.scope: Exact-scope authoritative catalog epochs fence old prepared requests before native send and through the existing currentness/settlement checks; optional cache retention is separate.

planItems.reason: Retain reviewed CLI 2.142.0 identity. Hub defaults to CLI 2.168.2 with logical-turn/root equality; cli2api uses CLI 2.176.0 and conversation-request=session without root. No independent same-version/product/site receipt resolves this difference or authorizes a mixed identity bundle. Stable conversation IDs alone do not prove upstream history storage, cache benefit or latency improvement.

snapshotPolicy.changed_authoritative_catalog: advance epoch even when optional payload caching is refused
snapshotPolicy.equal_catalog_while_snapshot_alive: preserve epoch; old prepared admission TTL is not extended
snapshotPolicy.explicit_invalidation: advance epoch and clear optional cached value; ABA body restoration cannot revive old generations
snapshotPolicy.optional_cache_eviction: does not revoke snapshots or remove their scope revocation channel
snapshotPolicy.fresh_prepared_admission: original 8-minute TTL checked immediately before the conservative Sent boundary
snapshotPolicy.transient_stale_prepare: existing explicit transient-only fallback up to 24 hours; no new stale/static authorization
snapshotPolicy.failed_management_refresh: marks retained entry stale; unchanged old fresh prepared grant may finish its original TTL; no invented revocation fact
snapshotPolicy.already_admitted_response: TTL alone does not cancel; authoritative epoch changes use existing failure/observed-usage settlement and never replay generation
snapshotPolicy.resource_bounds: reuse existing 128-scope/flight bound and parent owner; cached-only leases may be evicted; active snapshots and waiters remain pinned

redEvidence.result: empty/tool/default authoritative replacement each still sent one old prepared POST

validation.rustInputDigestMethod: sha256 of canonical path/sha256 array; src/tests Rust plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock/build.rs

limitations: Local fixture evidence is not vendor acceptance.
